senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; דמי)resemblance, image, esp. man’s divine image (Gen. I, 26).
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 63b:17">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>כאילו ממעט הד׳</he> as though he diminished the divine image (by neglecting the propagation of man).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:20">Num. R. s. 19</cite> <he>מדמין ד׳ גבורה של מעלה וכ׳</he> they compare the appearance of Divinity to the shape of man; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דְּמוּיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 33:1">Pesik. R. s. 33</cite> <he>כמה ד׳ נדמיתי וכ׳</he> in how many images (visions) did I appear to you!—
Yalk. Ex. 422 שני ד׳ אחד וכ׳(!) two embroidered designs, one on each side.
